products_and_services.business_model: Matrimony.com Limited is India's leading online matchmaking and marriage services company. The business monetizes through consumer subscription plans (paid memberships) for profile access and communication on its matchmaking platforms, personalized matchmaking services, and vendor marketplace listing fees.

offerings.name: Matchmaking Portals & Apps
offerings.description: Operates flagship portal BharatMatrimony, regional matchmaking platforms (TamilMatrimony, TeluguMatrimony, KeralaMatrimony, MarathiMatrimony, etc.), and community-specific portals.
offerings.evidence_excerpt: pioneered online matchmaking in India with flagship brand BharatMatrimony alongside over 300 community and regional portals.

offerings.name: Personalized & Premium Matchmaking
offerings.description: High-touch premium services under EliteMatrimony and AssistedMatrimony for affluent individuals and families requiring dedicated relationship managers.
offerings.evidence_excerpt: EliteMatrimony caters to the affluent segment offering bespoke, confidential matchmaking services with relationship managers.

offerings.name: Vernacular Matchmaking App ('Jodii')
offerings.description: Mobile application targeting non-graduates, blue-collar workers, and tier-2/3/4 demographics in multiple Indian vernacular languages.
offerings.evidence_excerpt: Jodii was launched to address the mass matchmaking market for non-graduates across tier-2 and tier-3 towns.

offerings.name: Marriage Services (Wedding Ecosystem)
offerings.description: Wedding vendor discovery platform WeddingBazaar (photographers, caterers, decorators) and venue booking marketplace Mandap.com (WeddingMandaps).
offerings.evidence_excerpt: marriage services encompass WeddingBazaar for wedding vendor bookings and Mandap.com for wedding venue discovery.

operating_segments.description: Online matchmaking subscriptions, assisted services, and digital profile communication fees.
operating_segments.revenue_contribution: ₹46,380 Lakhs (~₹463.8 crore; ~98.1% of operating revenue in FY 2023-24)
operating_segments.evidence_excerpt: Matchmaking segment revenue stood at ₹46,380 lakhs compared to ₹44,988 lakhs in the previous financial year.

operating_segments.description: Listing fees, commissions, and transaction charges from wedding vendors, venue listings, and photography services.
operating_segments.revenue_contribution: ₹899 Lakhs (~₹9.0 crore; ~1.9% of operating revenue in FY 2023-24)
operating_segments.evidence_excerpt: Marriage services segment generated revenue of ₹899 lakhs during the year ended March 31, 2024.

geographical_breakdown.domestic_india: ₹41,015 Lakhs (~₹410.15 crore; ~86.7% of customer contract revenue in FY 2023-24)
geographical_breakdown.international_nri: ₹6,264 Lakhs (~₹62.64 crore; ~13.3% of customer contract revenue in FY 2023-24, catering to NRI diaspora in the US, Middle East, UK, and Canada)
geographical_breakdown.evidence_excerpt: Revenue from customers within India was ₹41,015 lakhs while revenue from customers outside India was ₹6,264 lakhs.

operating_geographies.facilities: Corporate headquarters, principal software engineering center, centralized operations, and data center coordination.
operating_geographies.evidence_excerpt: registered office and corporate headquarters located in MRC Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

operating_geographies.facilities: Over 100 retail centers, regional operations branches, and tele-advisory centers across major Indian metros and tier-2/3 cities.
operating_geographies.evidence_excerpt: maintains a physical network of over 100 retail outlets across India providing assisted matchmaking services.

operating_geographies.facilities: Offices and digital acquisition hubs catering to the Indian diaspora in the United States, United Arab Emirates, and United Kingdom.
operating_geographies.evidence_excerpt: international operations cater to non-resident Indians across key overseas markets.

named_customers.details: Matrimony.com operates an exclusively direct-to-consumer (B2C) model serving individual users. In FY 2023-24, the company recorded over 1.07 million paid profile subscriptions across its platforms. No individual consumer or institutional customer accounts for a significant portion of revenue, and retail customer names are proprietary and confidential.
named_customers.evidence_excerpt: added over 1.07 million paid subscriptions during the year, serving individual consumer subscribers across matchmaking platforms.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Primary cloud provider hosting core matchmaking platforms, scalable database infrastructure, and analytical workloads.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: completed the migration of its core digital infrastructure to Amazon Web Services to achieve dynamic scalability.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Primary Android app distribution channel and key digital marketing vendor for search and app install advertisements.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: Google Play Store serves as the primary distribution channel for mobile applications downloaded on Android devices.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Mobile app distribution channel for iOS operating systems.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: distributes native mobile matchmaking applications via the Apple App Store for iOS users.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Digital marketing and user acquisition channel via Facebook and Instagram.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: utilizes digital advertising channels including search engines and social media networks for customer acquisition.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Commercial payment aggregators providing UPI, credit card, and net banking gateways are utilized across mobile and web platforms but not individually named in annual report notes.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: integrates multiple licensed digital payment gateways to enable seamless subscription payments.

business_dependencies.description: Heavily reliant on the Google Play Store (Android) and Apple App Store for user downloads, app updates, and in-app subscription renewals.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: majority of user registrations and engagement originate from mobile applications downloaded through app store platforms.

business_dependencies.description: Operations require 24/7 high availability, rapid profile search latency, and data integrity provided by AWS cloud systems and data caching layers.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: uninterrupted availability of cloud computing infrastructure is vital to support millions of concurrent user sessions.

business_dependencies.description: Business growth depends on cost-effective digital marketing on Google and Meta platforms to replenish the subscriber funnel as existing users marry and exit.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: advertising and marketing expenses are critical to maintain brand recall and generate continuous user registrations.

business_dependencies.description: Handles sensitive personal data (photographs, government IDs, horoscopes, family backgrounds), creating high dependency on data protection frameworks like the DPDP Act 2023.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: compliance with data protection legislation and safeguarding personal user information is critical to business continuity.

announced_plans.plan_title: Expansion and Monetization of 'Jodii' Vernacular App
announced_plans.description: Aggressive scaling of the Jodii matchmaking app across Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, and other regional dialects to capture the mass non-graduate demographic.
announced_plans.status: Rapid adoption phase, testing low-ticket pricing packages and vernacular advertising campaigns.
announced_plans.evidence_excerpt: expanding marketing initiatives for Jodii to accelerate adoption across non-metro and vernacular language segments.

announced_plans.plan_title: Deployment of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Matchmaking
announced_plans.description: Implementing proprietary AI algorithms for automated profile screening, facial recognition photo verification, anti-fraud moderation, and behavioral recommendation modeling.
announced_plans.evidence_excerpt: deploying artificial intelligence and machine learning models to improve recommendation accuracy and enhance automated profile moderation.

announced_plans.plan_title: Wedding Services Restructuring & Path to Profitability
announced_plans.description: Streamlining WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com by refocusing on high-margin vendor listing categories and wedding photography to reduce cash burn.
announced_plans.evidence_excerpt: restructuring operations in the marriage services business to optimize costs and move towards operational break-even.

material_risks.risk_title: App Store Service Fees & Monopolistic Dispute with Google
material_risks.description: Google's enforcement of its User Choice Billing policy (levying 11% to 26% service fees) resulted in the brief delisting of over 100 Matrimony.com apps from the Google Play Store on March 1, 2024, creating acute distribution disruption before reinstatement.
material_risks.status: Subject to active antitrust litigation and review before the Competition Commission of India (CCI) and appellate courts.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: Google delisted multiple apps on March 1, 2024 over service fee policies; company initiated legal remedies.

material_risks.risk_title: Compliance Liabilities under Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) 2023
material_risks.description: The enactment of the DPDP Act 2023 introduces strict requirements for user consent architecture, data fiduciary obligations, right of erasure, and substantial penalties (up to ₹250 crore) for security breaches.
material_risks.status: Ongoing compliance readiness and technical alignment.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: the Digital Personal Data Protection Act imposes stringent obligations on data fiduciaries regarding user consent and privacy.

material_risks.risk_title: Digital Advertising Inflation and CAC Volatility
material_risks.description: Rising cost-per-click (CPC) rates across Google and Meta advertising networks could elevate user acquisition costs, depressing EBITDA margins if subscription pricing power is constrained.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: inflation in digital advertising costs could increase customer acquisition expenses and impact profitability.

material_risks.risk_title: Platform Integrity, Impersonation and Cyber Fraud Risks
material_risks.description: Malicious actors creating fake profiles or attempting financial scams on matrimonial platforms expose the company to reputational damage and regulatory scrutiny under consumer protection and IT regulations.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: maintaining trust and safety against fraudulent profiles and identity misuse requires constant monitoring and verification.

event_pathways.pathway_title: Competition Commission / Judicial Ruling on Google Play Store Commissions
event_pathways.mechanism: A binding regulatory directive capping app store commissions or enforcing non-discriminatory billing preserves up to 15-26% of digital subscription billing margins from platform levies.
event_pathways.evidence_excerpt: resolution of the Google Play billing dispute will directly influence distribution costs and in-app monetization margins.

event_pathways.pathway_title: Notification and Enforcement of Rules under DPDP Act 2023
event_pathways.mechanism: Operational guidelines issued by the Data Protection Board will necessitate compliance audits, user data consent revamps, and potential structural adjustments to user profile indexing.
event_pathways.evidence_excerpt: statutory data protection frameworks necessitate formal consent management systems and data governance investments.

event_pathways.pathway_title: Digital Advertising Rate Inflation (Google & Meta Ad Spend Elasticity)
event_pathways.mechanism: A 15-20% increase in programmatic ad rates on search and social channels elevates blended customer acquisition costs, forcing either lower marketing intensity or price hikes on subscription tiers.
event_pathways.evidence_needed: Disclosure of quarterly blended customer acquisition costs (CAC), payback periods, and organic versus paid profile registration ratios in investor presentations.

event_pathways.mechanism: Transitioning Jodii from free user acquisition to positive unit economics expands the total addressable market beyond Tier-1 graduates into Tier-2/3 working demographics.
event_pathways.evidence_excerpt: scaling Jodii into a monetizable product expands the addressable demographic base across regional markets.
